tone.target: jangly French pop-rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.profile: jangly French pop-rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.summary: A clean, compressed signal chain utilizing a British-style amp and cabinet to achieve bright, jangly, and punchy pop-rock rhythms with clear pick articulation.
corrections: keep it more pop than hard rock

rig.name: BB Brunes - coups et blessures - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up background noise and hum.
Provide light, articulate grit and boost the upper mids for jangle.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a clean, slightly broken-up Vox/P-90 edge tone.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and focused on natural guitar resonance.
blocks.gap: No dedicated drive is needed after Green OD; keeping this module bypassed maintains clarity.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate British tone (Vox/Marshall edge) required for pop-rock.
blocks.gap: The UK SLP is chosen for its classic, punchy, and upper-mid focused character.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary upper-mid punch.
blocks.gap: The UK Vintage 4x12 is a good proxy for the desired 'Vox/Marshall' feel in a pop context.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the bright bite and upper mids (jangle) while controlling low-end mud.
blocks.gap: Used to specifically dial in the 'bright bite' and 'jangly' quality requested.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle width and shimmer to the jangle without sounding overly ambient.
blocks.gap: A light Chorus adds necessary pop texture and helps the tone cut through a mix, fulfilling the 'jangle' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle space and depth without creating an 'ambient wash'.
blocks.gap: A low-mix Room reverb provides necessary dimension for pop recording while avoiding excessive tail.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism to better capture the bright, articulate British tone required for pop-rock jangle.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Bright 4x12 IR (e.g., Vox AC30 or Fender Twin)
proposals.reason: The current IR is generic; a specific bright British cab will enhance the jangle and bite.
